scope.body_policy: ZIP central directories first; only exact matched member/direct file at or below 64 MiB was read

notes: An exact usable classification requires bytes from a direct file or exact ZIP member and image/SWF validation where applicable.
Catalog or manifest path/status/hash references without a readable body remain metadata_only_or_unvalidated.
Same-basename members/files at a different path are candidates only; they are not substituted for the requested route.
This is a scoped local-layer result, not a claim about all historical sources.
